You'll ensure the components are positioned correctly, keep a close eye on the welding process and check the end result. In this way, you'll combine your own craftsmanship with modern production technology. During your work, you'll be in regular contact with colleagues in production to find the best solutions together. Do you have a strong background in electrical and mechanical maintenance and would you like to work with advanced logistics systems? Then this could be your next opportunity. In this role, you will help ensure the optimal operation, availability, and reliability of automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment. You will work in a high-tech environment where automation, precision, safety, and continuous improvement are essential. You are a hands-on technician who enjoys working in a dynamic and highly automated environment. You approach technical problems in a structured way and remain calm when equipment unexpectedly stops or priorities change. Rather than simply solving the immediate issue, you look for the underlying cause and consider how similar problems can be prevented in the future. Because you will work closely with internal and external customers, colleagues, and suppliers, clear communication is essential. You are able to explain technical issues in an understandable way and understand the importance of good service. By keeping automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment running reliably, you directly contribute to the continuity of ASML's production process.
